assertions.description: This suite specifies negative authorization, input limits, origin policy, credential separation, and safe failures. Deterministic inputs and expected outcomes are required.
Identical assertions target the main organization and isolated test fixture.
Live status is forbidden until hosted execution retains redacted evidence.
Unauthenticated and wrong-realm requests stop before any rate-limit or Redis lookup.
Forwarded identity is considered only for configured trusted peers, and raw identity values never enter receipts.
Only versioned opaque HMAC-shaped rate-limit keys are accepted; raw tenant or principal material fails closed.
The local Redis-backed LRU may short-circuit active denials but may never cache permits or over-admit traffic.
Strict enforcement rejects Redis unavailability and telemetry emits approved key names only, never sensitive values.
Production startup rejects enabled test bypass or fault injection before serving traffic.
